title: Irrationality of cubic threefolds after one stabilization
description: This manuscript proves unconditionally that X times P1 is irrational for every smooth complex cubic threefold X. Its quantum proof uses one occurrence-indexed categorical ledger for generic even quantum-D-module blocks. Iritani's blowup comparison and the Iritani--Koto projective-bundle comparison give the ledger's operation laws. A direct rank-two residue fold, computed from Beauville's cubic quantum products, has value one on X, vanishes on every possible point, curve, or surface center, doubles on X times P1, and vanishes on P4. A finer fold counts primitive-sixth framed formal monodromy: nu_6(X) = 2 and nu_6(X times P1) = 4 unconditionally, while its birational invariance through dimension four is conditional on Hypotheses 5.7R and the residual part of 5.7T. The integral cycle-theoretic results and irrationality of V times P1 for every smooth prime Fano threefold V of genus eight are also unconditional. The cycle argument proves all-degree integral saturation for marked finite-etale graph quotients of elliptic powers and constructs a non-isotrivial A5-invariant family whose members are universally CH0-trivial, so universal CH0-triviality and rationality after one stabilization separate unconditionally on the same stabilized varieties.
